title: Smartphone Prices Increase in Pakistan
excerpt: Handset prices from major brands have risen significantly in Karachi, with increases ranging between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 30,000.
body_html:
Smartphone prices have experienced a sharp increase in Karachi. According to reports, major handset brands have raised their prices significantly.

The price adjustments range from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 30,000 per device. This sudden jump affects mobile phone buyers in the region, making handsets noticeably more expensive across major brands.
